mathlit_perspective.definition: The point of view a story is told from, which decides what the reader can and cannot see.
mathlit_perspective.example: From the perspective of the night engineer, the quiet building is the whole story.

mia_framing.definition: The choice of words around a fact, which changes how the fact feels.
mia_framing.example: The framing changed nothing: 400 a month is the same money as 4,800 a year.
